# GunneryChips

Gunnery co-processor chips: a player uses one on a gunnery control server to raise its processing power for good
(`WFGunneryChipSystem`), up to three chips a server; examining the server shows what is fitted. Three tiers add 6, 12
and 24. They aren't sold or made anywhere: they turn up in crates in the holds of crashed ships on planets
(`_WF/PlanetPois/wreck_loot.yml`), beside crates of salvaged ship guns.
